name: Escape Through Stealth
label: Quest
description: In Darkshore, Volcor needs help escaping a furbolg den. Guide the trapped night elf scout past hostile beasts, then report to Terenthis in Auberdine.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshore, Volcor needs help escaping a furbolg den. Guide the trapped night elf scout past hostile beasts, then report to Terenthis in Auberdine.

Volcor, a night elf scout sent to investigate Darkshore's mounting threats, is trapped inside a furbolg cave. Cut off from the main roads and outnumbered, he needs an ally to help him escape before the furbolgs discover him.
Volcor chooses a careful path through the cave instead of charging the corrupted denizens. Once outside, he runs ahead on foot and asks you to meet him in Auberdine, where he can travel faster alone.

Back in Auberdine, you bring news of Volcor's rescue to Terenthis, a night elf leader working to protect the troubled coast. Volcor's safe return shows that discipline and teamwork can resist the darkness spreading through Darkshore and the wilderness beyond.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All right then... If you're sure, we'll sneak out of here. Let us leave when you're ready.
Remember, after you've escaped, meet Terenthis back in Auberdine. I'll head there on my own since I'll probably be moving faster than you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend! I'm pleased to see you've returned successfully. Your assistance to Volcor has given me faith that we can overcome the challenges facing us here in Darkshore and beyond.
